verdict.rationale: Fellow documents a REST Developer API that exposes notes in Fellow Markdown (GFM plus extensions), diarized transcripts and action items with pagination. Its Super Admin API explicitly supports retrieving and exporting workspace data to back up notes and transcripts. However, bulk export is gated to Enterprise super admins, the API requires a paid plan and can be disabled by admins, and leaving means scripting it yourself against paginated endpoints. Missing for 10: a self-serve bulk export or download-all feature for individual users, documented export of audio/video recordings, open-format export without a paid or Enterprise plan, and independent corroboration that a full export works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
